title: Northgate Cash Tenure Bonus for Long-Standing Members
content:
**Rule.** The longer a membership has run, the more its Cash earns: under the consumer earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the member's tenure adds percentage points to the earning percentage of the line the schedule settles, measured from the membership's term start date to the order's fulfilled date in whole calendar months:

| Whole calendar months from the term start date to the fulfilled date | Points added |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0.5 |
| 12 to fewer than 24 | 0.25 |
| fewer than 12 | none |

A whole calendar month is counted when the fulfilled date reaches the same day of the month as the term start date. Where the membership record carries no term start date, the line adds no points.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical term start date 15 March 2029)**

| Fulfilled date | Whole calendar months | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2030 | 11 | none |
| 15 March 2030 | 12 | 0.25 |
| 14 March 2031 | 23 | 0.25 |
| 15 March 2031 | 24 | 0.5 |

**Basis Q&A**

*Does a long stretch on an earlier membership record count?* The months are counted from the term start date recorded on the membership that earns the Cash.
